summary: Two of four snowmobilers from the Tucker Ponds trailhead caught in an avalanche in the Lost Mine Creek drainage; one partially buried, one completely buried and killed; 911 call ~6 p.m.
location: Lost Mine Creek drainage, east of Wolf Creek Pass
responding_agency: Mineral County Sheriff's Office; Rio Grande County Sheriff's Office; Wolf Creek Ski Area
notes: Per CAIC report quoted in CPR article; third avalanche death in Colorado that winter; complete burial fatal, partial burial survived. Run 61 CAIC merge: CAIC 2015-16 season table row — 2 caught, 1 partially buried, 1 fully buried and killed, Lost Mine Creek east of Wolf Creek Pass. Run 420 merge: SnowBrains 2016-02-03 retelling confirms same incident (group of four from Tucker Ponds trailhead, 2 caught in Lost Mine Creek drainage, 6 p.m. 911 call, Mineral + Rio Grande County SO + Wolf Creek Ski Area search).
